item.tib: rtsa gsum bon skyongs bzhi bsgrag kyi sgrub pa'i las byang phrin las kun 'grubs
item.coloph: ces pa 'di yang grwa slob sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig gis bon skyong spyi 'dus kyi tshogs 'khor khyer bde dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba dang/ 'phral du rgyas shod kyi grwa rgyun tshul khrims rnam dag nas/ nan tan chen pos nye bar bskyal ba la brten nas/ lung zin mdo smad zhig po bco brgyad kyi nang tshan/ skam zhig grub thob thod dkar gyi gdung rgyud yin khul tsam mkhan ming pa nyi ma bstan 'dzin dbang gi rgyal por 'bod pa bdag gis lha srung la bka' yi gnang ba dang/ brtag pa bgyis pa'i nub mor rmi lam du/ nub phyogs nas bud med rgyan dang ldan pa zhig gi (gis) bla chen po dran pa nam mkhas mdzad pa'i rtsa gsum bon skyong bzhi bsgrag (sbrags) kyi bsgrub (sgrub) pa 'bring po yin zer ba'i pod chung zhig lag tu gtad byung ba'i nyams dang / de'i mtshams rgyal chen shel khrab can gyis sprul pa'i gzugs bstan te/ dga' zhing legs pa'i rnam 'gyur dpag tu med par bstan pa dang / rang sems la'ang gzhung lugs 'di lta bu yin 'dug snyam pa'i bag chags gsal por shar ba la sogs la brten nas/ brtsams pa'i dbu tshugs te sa sprel lo sgron zla ba'i 'phel phyogs tshes bcu'i nyin la sman ri'i bla brang du grub par bgyis pa dge bas mnyam med bla ma'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
